train.natural_sampling_qualification: Natural membership is identity-verified, but these selected-checkpoint predictions traverse the original augmented actor stream. The extra selected actions affect transition-gap features and, for L01, latent filter updates. Natural-row point scores are in-sample diagnostics, not a matched natural-cadence replay or evidence isolating group shift. Root-gap strata are reported separately; no nonconsecutive rows are stitched.

consecutive_root_command_runs.interpretation: Nonoverlapping windows within genuine consecutive selected own roots, reset at every unobserved action gap/actor boundary. Teacher-forced personal observations/past commands; not autonomous rollouts or strategic-success percentages. All original rows also remain in the full benchmark.
